question: In which of the following states is the famous Chitradurga Fort located?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Karnataka.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Chitradurga Fort is located in Karnataka.**
